summary: Completed UI/UX testing of Project Management Module's cream/beige styling enhancement. All features working correctly - sidebar menu structure with 'Project Management' main section containing 'My Tasks' and 'All Projects' sub-items, correct route highlighting, and consistent cream/beige color scheme across both pages.

sidebar_project_management_section.details: Project Management section visible in sidebar with FolderKanban icon and rose-600/rose-700 color theme

sidebar_sub_items.details: Sub-items 'My Tasks' (ListTodo icon) and 'All Projects' (FolderKanban icon) visible under expanded section

sidebar_highlighting_my_tasks.details: My Tasks link highlighted with bg-[#E8D5C4] when on /projects/my-tasks route

sidebar_highlighting_all_projects.details: All Projects link highlighted with bg-[#E8D5C4] when on /projects route

my_tasks_cream_color_scheme.details: Page uses cream/beige colors: white cards with #E8D5C4 border, #FDF8F3 background on sections, #4A3728/#5D4A3A text

my_tasks_stats_cards.details: 4 stats cards (Total Assigned, Due Today, Overdue, Completed) with consistent styling

my_tasks_tabs.details: 4 tabs (All Tasks, In Progress, Pending Review, Recently Done) with rose-600 active state and #F5EBE0 inactive state

my_tasks_task_sections.details: Task sections (Due Today, Pending Review, All Assigned) display correctly with cream background

projects_list_cream_color_scheme.details: Projects page uses same cream colors: stats cards, filter bar with #FDF8F3 background

projects_list_stats_cards.details: 4 stats cards (Total Projects, Active, Completed, On Hold) styled consistently

projects_list_filters.details: Search and filter dropdowns styled with #D4BBA6 borders on cream background

projects_list_cards.details: Project cards have #E8D5C4 border, PRJ-XXXX badges, progress bars

navigation_my_tasks.details: Click on 'My Tasks' correctly navigates to /projects/my-tasks

navigation_all_projects.details: Click on 'All Projects' correctly navigates to /projects

rose_accent_buttons.details: Primary action buttons use rose-600 (All Projects, New Project, active tabs)

critical_code_review_comments: Code is well-structured with consistent color palette across components
All interactive elements have appropriate data-testid attributes
Navigation highlighting logic correctly detects active routes
context_for_next_testing_agent: Project Management module UI/UX has been enhanced to match cream/beige color scheme. Sidebar has collapsible 'Project Management' section with 'My Tasks' and 'All Projects' sub-items. Both routes have proper highlighting. Color palette: #4A3728 (dark text), #5D4A3A (muted text), #E8D5C4 (cream border), #F5EBE0 (light cream bg), #FDF8F3 (lightest cream), rose-600 for accent buttons.
